title: What Post-Quantum Cryptography Enclaves Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Post-quantum cryptography enclaves are hardened hardware modules that run cryptographic algorithms believed safe against quantum computers — lattice, hash, and code-based schemes — inside tamper-resistant secure elements, so keys stay protected even when quantum attacks arrive. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Post-Quantum Cryptography Enclaves: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Post-Quantum Cryptography Enclaves in one line: Post-quantum cryptography enclaves are hardened hardware modules that run cryptographic algorithms believed safe against quantum computers — lattice, hash, and code-based schemes — inside tamper-resistant secure elements, so keys stay protected even when quantum attacks arrive.
Why it matters: Quantum computers will break RSA and ECC; enclaves make the migration to quantum-safe crypto a hardware upgrade, not a crisis..
Where it is used: government communications, financial infrastructure, IoT device identity, long-life secrets..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.

t: Current Research State of Post-Quantum Cryptography Enclaves
title: Current Research State of Post-Quantum Cryptography Enclaves
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: NIST standardized ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA; vendors now ship PQC in HSMs and secure elements. Research focuses on side-channel-hardened implementations, hybrid classical+PQC handshakes, and crypto-agility. The gap: many deployed devices cannot be upgraded, and harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks make delay costly. Research moves in three waves: laboratory proof of concept, scaled prototypes under controlled conditions, and field trials. Post-Quantum Cryptography Enclaves currently sits at the stage described above, and the pieces records show what each wave still needs.
